note: rustre-ttd-query is a workspace library crate (TTD trace query engine: TimeRange, EventKind/TraceEvent, QueryFilter/QueryLogic, EventPattern (18 variants), QueryIndex, aggregations, CSV/DOT/JSON timeline export). It is NOT exposed via the MCP server: no references to ttd-query/TtdQuery in crates/rustre-mcp-tools. JSON-RPC stdio comparison against rustre-mcp.exe is therefore N/A; the pure-logic Python validator IS the ground-truth comparison.

checked_against_source.QueryFilter: MemoryRead/Write, Thread, CallTo/From, SyscallNumber, InTimeRange, ExceptionCode, ThreadCreate/Exit variants
checked_against_source.EventPattern: subset of 18 variants modeled (AnyMemRead/Write, AnyCall/Return/Syscall/Exception, MemReadAt/WriteAt, CallTo/From, SyscallNr, ThreadId, InPositionRange, Breakpoint)
checked_against_source.QueryIndex::build: by_address / calls_from / calls_to / syscalls / by_thread maps
